summary: Patch coverage for PRs: `coverage diff --patch --base <ref>` computes coverage over only the executable lines changed since the merge-base (same contract as `test --changed --base`), using the current run's coverage JSON (no baseline snapshot). Ships a rich terminal table, a JSON patch section, a `--patch-fail-under <N>` gate (exit 1), `::warning` GitHub Actions annotations on uncovered changed lines (auto when GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, `--patch-annotations` override), and a GH job markdown summary. Strict edge semantics: missing data = uncovered, new files fully counted, deleted files ignored, .gd-only, zero-plan files skipped.
